## [1.19.0](https://github.com/jordanwoodson/lurk-morphe-patches/compare/v1.18.0...v1.19.0) (2026-11-19)

### Twitch

#### ✨ New Features

* **Hide Home sections** can hide the Live tab
* **Keep Drops banner** shows a channel's Drops in native chat
* My 7TV badge shows your own 7TV badge on your messages

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Auto-claim Drops lets Drops progress with **Disable analytics** on
* **Hide Clips**' clip callback reads within its property cache

### Shared

#### ✨ New Features

* **Lurk icon** can switch back to the original icon in Lurk settings
